criteria.text: Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.2 is stated as $15,600,000 but 15% of the $130,000,000 Purchase Price is $19,500,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,300,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Penrith Technologies Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 22 April 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 22 October 2032 (72 months after Closing).
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (15% x $130,000,000 = $19,500,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $15,600,000.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (22 April 2028; 22 October 2032) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 6 August 2026 (625 days).
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
